description.narrative: Mujeres capacidadas e involucradas en acciones de networking y mentoring

comment.narrative: As the indicator refers to the number of women to be trained and involved in new networking and mentoring activities the baseline value is zero.

The Progress Report details the actions concerning training networking and mentoring implemented by the project.1560 beneficiary women financed en Ejecucin Directa2720 beneficiary women financed con Apoyo Directo a Terceros

The Progress Report 20172018 gives sufficient details about the activities carried out by the project to improve women empowerment.All monitoring data reported in the INFORME TECNICO nov2017 ago2018 refer to the countries covered by the intervention as a whole Bolivia Brasil Costa Rica El Salvador Guatemala Peru and Uruguay. No disaggregation of data by country is available at the moment. This note was added in the comment to the current value.
